coverage_claim: Original named study applications supplement specific regional dimensions. Supplied lot/site conditions remain givens; cost is not a quality or price guarantee. Country label mechanisms are cross-referenced, not duplicated by town. No claim of official assessment, expert verification, qualification completion or universal local practice.
